description: Use this when the guest has chosen a venue and wants it to get in touch: it forwards their request (dates, party, contact, message) to the venue at once. It is a request, not a booking: nothing is held or paid, and the venue contacts the guest directly. Check the details with the guest before calling. Give an idempotency_key and reuse it if you retry. Keep the status_token from the answer to call get_lead_status later. Don't use this to ask ATAbooking questions or to test.

age_bands.description: Attractions: people per age band, e.g. {"adult":2,"child":1}

idempotency_key.description: One per request (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -). Reuse it on retries to get the same request back.

language.description: The guest's language, e.g. en, th, de

message.description: Anything the guest wants the venue to know

time.description: Restaurants: the table time; attractions: the session time

unit_id.description: The room, table or ticket from get_venue, if the guest chose one

name: send_lead
title: Send the guest's request to the venue
